decisions.reason: A coupling protection cap is a low-investment accessory with little public commitment, so dropping it would cost little, but it is cheap to keep alongside the trailer range.
A multi-model box trailer line featured on the home page represents substantial tooling investment and visible commitment, so management will persist with it.
The car transporter line carries considerable development and production investment, and any early weak results can be attributed to market ramp-up, so management keeps it.
The low-bed series is a core, multi-model line promoted on the home page, so writing it off would expose the investment decision as a mistake.
The high-cover series is a publicly showcased product line central to the range, so commitment favors continuing it.
This second box trailer series is promoted on the home page and fits the core range, but its overlap with B makes consolidation somewhat more likely.
